# APIGatewayMatrix - Cloud-Native API Gateway Latency, Plugin Overhead & Reverse Proxy Shootouts

> Authority reference dataset and benchmarks for Cloud-Native API Gateways & Reverse Proxy Benchmarks.
> All metrics and guides are 100% free and open-source.

## Core Architectural Guides
- [Traefik vs Kong API Gateway: p99 Latency & Memory Footprint](https://apigatewaymatrix.pages.dev/traefik-vs-kong-api-gateway-latency-benchmark/): Complete engineering guide and technical benchmarks for Traefik vs Kong API Gateway: p99 Latency & Memory Footprint in high-performance production systems.
- [Caddy vs Nginx in 2026: Automatic HTTPS & Benchmarks](https://apigatewaymatrix.pages.dev/caddy-vs-nginx-performance-ssl-automation-shootout/): Architectural analysis and total cost of ownership shootout for Caddy vs Nginx in 2026: Automatic HTTPS & Benchmarks.
- [Envoy Proxy Global Rate Limiting: Redis Service Setup](https://apigatewaymatrix.pages.dev/envoy-proxy-global-rate-limiting-redis-config/): Step-by-step implementation guide, code snippets, and automated testing procedures for Envoy Proxy Global Rate Limiting: Redis Service Setup.
